item.title: Cold snap to bring frost, ice and snow to Northern Sound region
item.description: A cold snap is set to hit the Northern Sound region this week, with frost, ice, freezing fog and snow in places. The worst of the icy conditions is expected across Ulster and parts of north Connacht, with snow likely on higher ground from tomorrow into Saturday. Temperatures could drop as low as minus five degrees in some inland areas, and daytime highs will struggle to rise above freezing in parts of the north and north-west. item.title: Auto-enrolment pension scheme begins today
item.description: After many years of highlighting a pension scheme for all, the auto-enrolment scheme begins today. Last year the former minister Heather Humphreys signed the commencement notices for the scheme. From today, the employee, the employer and the state all contribute to auto-enrolment. Advertisement Under the system, if you are not paying into a pension scheme, you will be automatically enrolled.. item.title: Average farm income forecast to fall 19% in 2026
item.description: The average farm income in 2026 is forecast to fall by 19%, to just over €40,000, largely driven by a decline in dairy income. That's according to a report published by economists in Teagasc. The report found that economic growth at the global level is expected to be lower than in 2025. Advertisement Taking the year as a whole, Irish milk prices in 2026 could be down by more than 20% on their average level for 2025. item.title: 7 people died on Cavan/Monaghan roads in 2025
item.description: 7 people died on Cavan and Monaghan roads during 2025. 5 lost their lives on Monaghan roads while 2 lost their roads in Cavan over the past year. Figures out today show 185 people lost their lives in 174 collisions in 2025. Advertisement The figure represents 14 more people losing their lives on national roads last year than in 2024.
